maharaja-red.$description: Maharaja Red — Primary action buttons, prominent alerts — a deep, energetic red that commands attention

tiger-orange.$description: Tiger Orange — Decorative accents in illustrations and brand elements

sunburst-yellow.$description: Sunburst Yellow — Decorative botanical fills and accent elements

ocean-deep-blue.$description: Ocean Deep Blue — Decorative botanical fills and accent elements

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Blue decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, headings, strong borders, and solid icon fills

paper-bark.$description: Paper Bark — Page background, light card surfaces, and ghost button backgrounds — creates a warm, soft base

snow-drift.$description: Snow Drift — Elevated card backgrounds, product surfaces, and crisp text on dark backgrounds

smoky-quartz.$description: Smoky Quartz — Muted text, placeholder text, and subtle outlined button borders

pale-ash.$description: Pale Ash — Very subtle elevation shadows, providing depth without harshness

sofia-pro.$description: Specific button text where a slightly bolder appearance is desired.

quincy-cf.$description: Headings and display text — strong and characterful due to its extra-bold nature, balancing legibility with a distinctive presence.
